description: Average and Marginal Capacity Credits of Renewable Energy and Battery Storage in the United States Power System is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors An Pham, Wesley Cole (Accelerated Deployment and Decision Support Center). This dataset contains capacity credit values of solar PV, onshore and offshore wind, and 4-hour and 8-hour battery storage at the ReEDS' BA region resolution. The dataset is an output of the 2023 Standard Scenarios, generated using the Regional Energy Deployment System (ReEDS) model. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 106 files. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
